dict.string: SUBQUERY(extensionItems, $item, SUBQUERY($item.attachments, $a, NOT (ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.image" OR ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.plain-text" OR (ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.url" AND NONE $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.file-url"))).@count > 0).@count == 0 AND SUBQUERY(extensionItems, $item, $item.attachments.@count > 0).@count > 0 AND SUBQUERY(extensionItems, $item, SUBQUERY($item.attachments, $a, ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.image").@count > 1).@count == 0 AND SUBQUERY(extensionItems, $item, SUBQUERY($item.attachments, $a, ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.image").@count > 0).@count <= 1 AND SUBQUERY(extensionItems, $item, SUBQUERY($item.attachments, $a, (ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.url" AND NONE $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.file-url")).@count > 1).@count == 0 AND SUBQUERY(extensionItems, $item, SUBQUERY($item.attachments, $a, (ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.url" AND NONE $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.file-url")).@count > 0).@count <= 1
